Generated Narrative: CodeSystem sleep-architecture-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://mitre.org/fhir/space-health/CodeSystem/sleep-architecture-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
total-sleep-time Total Sleep Time (TST)Total time spent asleep during the recording period
sleep-efficiency Sleep EfficiencyPercentage of time in bed spent asleep
sleep-onset-latency Sleep Onset Latency (SOL)Time from lights-off to first epoch of sleep
waso Wake After Sleep Onset (WASO)Total wake time after initial sleep onset
rem-latency REM LatencyTime from sleep onset to first REM period
n1-pct N1 Sleep PercentagePercentage of total sleep time in stage N1 (light sleep)
n2-pct N2 Sleep PercentagePercentage of total sleep time in stage N2
n3-pct N3/SWS Sleep PercentagePercentage of total sleep time in stage N3 slow-wave sleep
rem-pct REM Sleep PercentagePercentage of total sleep time in REM sleep
